findings.title: Practice Log work dialog reopens itself after every action and stacks on each redraw (#/creatives/log/<id>)
findings.evidence: eval: after cr.promote click count of [data-ui="cr.dialog"] stays 1 with button now 'Promote…'; after KOS.rerender() count 1 -> 2; js/modules/creatives.js:567 'if (wid && CR().work(wid)) setTimeout(function () { openWork(wid); }, 0);' inside logPage; :542 and :559 call d.close(); KOS.rerender(); landing routes js/modules/crwrite.js:147, crdrills.js:85, creatives.js:620 | RECHECK 8 Nov (kos-redraw-1): eval cr2/rc1.js on kos-redraw-1: Promote -> dialog count 1 with 'Take out of Portfolio'; explicit KOS.rerender() -> 2 dialogs; navigation to #/creatives/portfolio and #/home -> still 2 (the redraw stopgap only holds BACKGROUND redraws; an explicit rerender still stacks)
findings.rootCause: Render-time side effect: logPage opens a dialog from the route arg on every render, and the route keeps the id.
findings.fix: Open the deep-linked dialog only on navigation, not on redraw (check KOS.ui.redrawing / a one-shot flag), and after opening replace the route with #/creatives/log (KOS.show with replace) or clear the id when the dialog closes; the row's open state can stay as a highlight.

findings.title: On iPhone, Creatives settings (and Start focus) cannot be reached: the gear lives in the page actions, which the phone shell hides
findings.evidence: eval --size iphone on #/subject/creatives: [data-ui="cr.settings-open"] height 0, hidden by DIV.k-stage-head; [data-ui="cr.focus"] height 0; section menu items as listed (no Settings); css/layout.css:445 ':root[data-shell="ready"] .k-stage-head { display: none; }'; js/modules/mobile-shell.js:559-562 (moves only [data-phone-action]); js/modules/creatives.js:69-70 settingsBtn and :295-296 spaceHead (no data-phone-action) | RECHECK 8 Nov (kos-redraw-1): eval --size iphone on #/subject/creatives: [cr.settings-open] 0x0, [cr.focus] 0x0
findings.rootCause: Space page actions are not marked for the phone title bar.
findings.fix: Mark the gear (and Start focus, or rely on the Focus tab) with data-phone-action so the phone title bar carries it, or add 'Settings' to KOS.crPages' phone menu.

findings.title: Rating a Creatives theory card never ticks the lesson's fourth check: syncAll() exists but nothing calls it, so mastery stays at 75% and the lesson never completes
findings.evidence: eval fixture audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/cr2/b1.js: afterPass '1110:started', cardHeld true, evidence [true,true,true,true], afterCard '1110:started', leafPct 75; grep -rn 'syncAll' js -> only js/core/creatives.js:247 (definition) and :481 (export); js/core/creatives.js:240-247; UI repro eval on #/ref/creatives/W1.3: before '1110', Theory cards tab -> Good -> after '1110', evAfter '1111', inspector '3 of 4 checks', leaf 75
findings.rootCause: The fourth check depends on another domain's record (the card schedule) but has no change hook; the repair function was written but never wired.
findings.fix: Call KOS.creatives.syncChecks for the card's lesson whenever a key starting 'creatives:' is rated (a hook in KOS.srs.rate like Code/Mind's syncConcept, or a 'kos-srs-rated' event), and run syncAll() once at boot to repair stuck lessons.

findings.title: A work dialog stays open over other pages after navigation (Back, hash change), stacking duplicates
findings.evidence: eval: [cr.dialog] count 1 after location.hash='#/creatives/portfolio', 2 after returning to log/<id>, still 2 on #/home; shots/creatives/n/dense-mac-portfolio.png (first capture: dialog of a removed work over Portfolio); js/core/ui.js:155 openDialog has no navigation hook; js/core/router.js:302 hashchange handler does not close open dialogs | RECHECK 8 Nov (kos-redraw-1): eval cr2/rc1.js: dialogs 2 after location.hash='#/creatives/portfolio', 2 on #/home
findings.rootCause: KOS.ui.openDialog dialogs are not tied to the route; the router never closes them.
findings.fix: In router.js, before rendering a navigation (not a redraw), close every open KOS.ui dialog (or have openDialog register a close on the next route change); keep it out of KOS.rerender.

findings.title: Creatives desk hero is taller than the other study spaces' heroes (341 vs 292-339 px) and its analytics card is stretched with empty bands

findings.title: A Writing study's '▶ Start' (and a project's 'Write it') makes a NEW draft every time instead of reopening the unfinished one
findings.evidence: eval: KOS.crWrite.openStudy('W1.1','a') twice -> #/creatives/write/mvzi1k0viya1 and #/creatives/write/mvzi1lmk5f7t; drafts list shows two identical rows; js/modules/crwrite.js:34-43 (openStudy/openMilestone always create()); js/modules/crtopic.js:40 and :71-72 (study card offers only '▶ Start'/'Another rep'); js/modules/creatives.js:601 | RECHECK 8 Nov (kos-redraw-1): eval: openStudy('W2.2','a') twice -> #/creatives/write/mw7l5pwfdtd7 and /mw7l5qmybfra, drafts 2 -> 4
findings.rootCause: Draft creation is not keyed to its study; the study card does not read drafts.
findings.fix: In openStudy/openMilestone look up the newest unsaved draft with the same lesson+study (or unit+ms) and open it; on the study card show 'Continue draft' when one exists, keeping 'Another rep' for a deliberate new one.

findings.title: Writing Desk 'Save to Practice Log' (and Add your work's Save) saves twice on a double tap

findings.title: A Writing study can be 'saved' with only the given setup text: the untouched 80% counts as made work

findings.fix: Refuse to save (toast 'Write your part first') while the text still equals the setup, or count only words beyond the setup (store setup length on the doc and use it for words/the guard).

findings.title: Writing Desk drafts cannot be deleted or tidied: every 'New draft' and every study Start adds a permanent row

findings.fix: Add a row menu (Delete with confirm, through KOS.ui.confirm danger), mark drafts already saved to the Practice Log ('Saved · 2 Nov'), and create a 'New draft' record only on first input.

findings.title: A unit project pays 150 XP, 40 gold and +10 HP for three 'Mark done' taps with no work saved
findings.evidence: eval on empty account: 3 x click 'Mark done' on #/creatives/project/A2 -> governor xp/gold [0,0] -> [150,40], creatives.paid {project:A2}, works 0; js/core/creatives.js:200-218 (markMilestone 'or by hand', pays when all reached); js/modules/creatives.js:~600 (Mark done button per milestone) | RECHECK 8 Nov (kos-redraw-1): eval on #/creatives/project/A3: 3x Mark done, works 0 -> xp/gold 172/20 -> 322/60
findings.rootCause: markMilestone accepts a bare tick as evidence and pays on it.
findings.fix: Let a hand-marked milestone count only when a work is attached (offer 'Attach a piece from the Practice Log' / 'Add your work' instead of a bare tick), or keep hand ticks for progress but pay the project only when each milestone has a saved work.

findings.title: Creatives settings 'Minutes' (10/20/30 min, 'How long a day's study runs') changes nothing: the Daily Creative ignores it

findings.fix: Either size the day by it (pick the study/cards that fit, or say 'about 20 min · this study runs 12') or remove the control.

findings.title: Work dialog: the picture sits left with a 252 px empty strip beside it, the note is jammed under it, and nothing says when/where the piece was made

findings.title: Tracks page: a track's bar says 33% while every unit row beside it says 0 / 3; an unreleased track draws a full-width empty bar

findings.title: Writing sprint: the word target is never measured; it only becomes text in the Focus objective
findings.evidence: js/modules/crwrite.js:160-176 (tgt only used in objective, area.focus() after KOS.rerender())
findings.rootCause: Sprint is a thin wrapper over Focus with no word tracking.
findings.fix: Record the word count at start, show 'n / 150 this sprint' in the foot while Focus runs, and focus the new textarea after the redraw.

findings.title: On a rest day the Daily Creative card says only 'Next on Monday': no way to do today's study anyway, and due theory cards are hidden
findings.evidence: shots/creatives/t/rest-mac.png; eval after setPrefs (today off): planDay().state 'rest', card children DIV 17 / IMG 80 / H2 23 px in a 238 px card; js/core/creatives.js:308-312, js/modules/creatives.js:173-174, :202
findings.rootCause: Rest state short-circuits the plan and the card has no actions for it.
findings.fix: On rest: keep 'Cards · n min' when cards are due and a quiet 'Do today's study anyway' link to the next study.

findings.title: 'Add your work' accepts confusing input: every piece is 'Untitled' and has no track, a link without https:// is refused as 'Choose a file or paste a link', a file and a link together silently drop the link, any other file is stored as text
findings.evidence: eval cr2/add.js: md -> ['text','Untitled',7,null,null]; badlink -> added 0, toast 'Choose a file or paste a link.'; both -> text work, link dropped; pdf -> ['text','Untitled',3]; js/modules/creatives.js:611-640 (title value '', rec.track absent, link regex /^https?:\/\//, else-branch readAsText)
findings.rootCause: Minimal form with no validation or defaults.
findings.fix: Default the title to the file name (sans extension); add a track choice for free pieces; accept a bare domain by prefixing https:// or say 'Links start with https://'; refuse unsupported types by name.

findings.title: Global search does not find Creatives work: Portfolio pieces and Writing Desk drafts never appear (lessons do, via the spec)
findings.evidence: eval KOS.search.run: 'Ghosted lines' -> 'Specification:A1.1 · Ghosted lines'; 'Rain at the window' (a promoted work title) -> no groups; grep -n 'creatives' js/core/search.js -> no match
findings.rootCause: No search domain registered for Creatives.
findings.fix: Add a Creatives search domain over the Portfolio (titles, 'made from') and drafts, opening the work dialog / desk; keep the Practice Log out.

findings.title: References page: the lab's zoom − + Fit buttons are 24 px on iPad
findings.evidence: measure sweep cr2/l-ipadl-4.json and cr2/empty-ipad-*.json #/creatives/refs: button.k-lab-zoom-b '−' 24x24, '+' 24x24, [lab.zoom-fit] 'Fit' 30x24
findings.rootCause: Lab zoom buttons use a dense size with no coarse-pointer override.
findings.fix: Coarse-pointer sizing for .k-lab-zoom-b (44 px hit area via the shared token).

findings.title: A check link to a work that is not on this account ('Nothing to check here') is a dead end with no way onward
findings.evidence: shots/creatives/t/shop-azure-check-mac.png (azure-butterfly theme, #/creatives/check/<deleted id>); js/modules/creatives.js:341
findings.rootCause: emptyState called without action.
findings.fix: Give the empty state an action to the Practice Log (and the lesson when known).
